obligations.text: The protected roots taken from the product home are its top-level entries except worktrees and .DS_Store; every other entry, named by this product or not, is protected.
A multiply linked file inside a protected entry refuses the launch at the hardlink step, as before; a multiply linked file under the operator's worktrees does not.
The confinement's self-test sentinel and probe socket directory are created inside one fixed protected entry, boundary/, so the roots a confinement record names do not vary by launch.

sectionHeadings: 064: The protected set is the product home's entries
3.2 What the alias scan still refuses
record.summary: Amends spec 004 section 3.18 rule 2. The protected roots a confinement takes from the product home are the home's top-level entries, every one except a closed operator list (worktrees and Finder's .DS_Store), rather than the home as one root. An unknown or later entry is still protected. The self-test's sentinel and socket directory live in one fixed protected entry. A multiply linked file in a protected entry still refuses.
record.title: The protected set is the product home's entries, not the operator's worktrees
